//sources: FAF's tutorial API fills most of the library at runtime (see services/training.rs).
A published manifest fills the rest; point FAF_TRAINING_CATALOGUE_URL at it.
Only destinations this repository already relies on are listed here, because a
guessed URL in a shipped client is worse than a short catalogue.

the request goes with it already on their clipboard. Get it by turning on

//trainers: The training team, as tiles. Empty here on purpose: who coaches, and
whether they are still coaching, is theirs to state rather than this
client's to guess. A published manifest fills it; the shape is
{ name, fafId, role, topics, gameModes, ratingMin, ratingMax, languages,
discord, note, avatarUrl, accepting }, and only `name` is required.
//resources: Empty on purpose. Everything a player reads comes from the catalogue
repository, so that adding, retagging or withdrawing a guide is a commit
there rather than a client release. What ships here is the set of
destinations the client falls back to when it cannot reach the manifest:
the Discord invite, the forum categories, the wiki.
